faqs.a: Trucks must be parked on a paved surface outside of the public right-of-way In a public street right-of-way (regardless of zoning district) when the street is closed to vehicular traffic as part of a Special Event Permit In a public street right-of-way (regardless of zoning district) as part of a gathering of two or more food trucks with authorization from the Director On private property as provided in Section 3-1-4-2, Temporary Uses by Zoning District
